Aya ya leo

Aya rasmi ileile ya ukurasa wa Kiingereza

Psalm 98:1 (Biblia Takatifu (ULB))

“Oh, mwimbieni Yahwe wimbo mpya, kwa kuwa ametenda mambo ya ajabu; mkono wake wa kuume na mkono wake mtakatifu vimempa ushindi.”

Kitabu, sura, na aya ileile ya ukurasa wa Kiingereza. Maandishi hapo juu: Biblia Takatifu ULB (CC BY-SA 4.0, Door43). Mstari wa Kiingereza wa tovuti ni KJV.

Psalm 98:1 (KJV) “O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.”

Mafundisho ya aya hii bado ni Kiingereza. Aya hapo juu ndiyo aya rasmi ya leo — si aya ya faraja inayozunguka.

Kilichokuwa kikitokea

A new song because the Lord has done marvellous things — His salvation made known. The verse: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous.

Maana yake

O sing to the LORD a new song; for he has done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, has gotten him the victory.

Nani anasema

Israel’s congregation singing because He has already acted

Nani anasikia hii

Anyone who needs praise to answer what God has done — and you in the hour this verse is for: “O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous.”

Inavyosema leo (2026)

In 2026, O sing to the LORD a new song; for he has done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, has gotten him the victory. The verse still says: “O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous.”

Inavyokusemea sasa

This word is for you in the hour this verse is for: “O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous.”

Hatua moja ya uaminifu, leo tu

Write this where you will see it: “O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous.”

Sala rahisi

Lord, let this word be true in me today: “O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous”. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
